title: Automating the Expert Eye: A System-Agnostic Deep Learning Framework for Rare Event Discovery in Imbalanced Force Spectroscopy
abstract: arXiv:2606.09541v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Single-molecule force spectroscopy (SMFS) probes biomolecular mechanics at the single-molecule level, but high-throughput acquisition of force-extension curves creates a data processing bottleneck. Identifying rare specific unbinding events among thousands of noise-dominated traces still relies largely on manual visual inspection. Here, we present a deep learning workflow for the preliminary screening of severely imbalanced SMFS datasets. translated_title: 自动化“专家之眼”：面向不平衡力谱学中稀有事件发现的系统无关深度学习框架
translated_abstract: 单分子力谱（SMFS）能够在单分子水平上探测生物分子的力学特性，但力-延伸曲线的高通量采集带来了数据处理瓶颈。在数千条以噪声为主的轨迹中识别稀有的特异性解离事件，目前仍主要依赖人工目视检查。本研究提出了一种用于严重不平衡SMFS数据集初步筛选的深度学习工作流程。通过使用力-延伸曲线的二维图像表示，且不依赖系统特异性的物理先验，我们对采用焦点损失（focal loss）训练的改进版ResNet18架构进行了微调，并在 Ruminococcus champanellensis 细菌的 XMod-Doc/Coh 复合物的力学解折叠路径上进行了评估。在目标阳性率仅为1.34%（970条曲线中仅有13个阳性P_2事件）的留出测试集上，该模型实现了92.31%的召回率（13个事件中检出12个）和91.95%的特异性（957条阴性轨迹中880条被正确分类），可自动……
tldr: 该研究提出了一个基于改进ResNet18与焦点损失、无需系统特异性物理先验的深度学习框架，能够自动从严重不平衡的单分子力谱数据中筛查稀有解离事件，在阳性率仅1.34%的测试集上达到92.31%召回率和91.95%特异性。
en_tdlr: This study presents a system-agnostic deep learning framework based on a modified ResNet18 with focal loss that automatically screens rare unbinding events from severely imbalanced single-molecule force spectroscopy data, achieving 92.31% recall and 91.95% specificity at a test-set positive prevalence of just 1.34%.
